# Palette reference

Every Obol design token as a light and dark swatch. These are the semantic tokens defined on
`:root` (light) and `.dark` (dark) in `assets/styles/app.css` and exposed to Tailwind via
`@theme inline`, so each one drives the named utility shown alongside it.

!!! note "Generated, not hand-maintained"
    This page is produced by `mise run palette`, which reads the values straight out of
    `assets/styles/app.css`. After changing the palette, re-run it and commit the refreshed
    page - never edit the swatches here by hand. See [Frontend](frontend.md) for how the
    tokens are wired.
